'''Kydra''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="WS" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Kydra served the Republic during the [[Fall of Falleen]]. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] completely destroyed the Republic [[Task force/Legends|task force]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Kydra and seven other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the process.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kydra was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="WS" />
